args.query:
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) AS avg_reaction, (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) / 4 AS range FROM measurements
)
CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT * FROM measurements,
    (SELECT avg_reaction + 2 * range FROM stats) AS upper_limit,
    (SELECT avg_reaction - 2 * range FROM stats) AS lower_limit
WHERE reaction_ms < upper_limit AND reaction_ms > lower_limit;

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
WITH stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(reaction_ms) AS avg_reaction, (MAX(reaction_ms) - MIN(reaction_ms)) / 4 AS range FROM measurements
)
SELECT * FROM measurements
WHERE reaction_ms < (SELECT avg_reaction + 2 * range FROM stats)
AND reaction_ms > (SELECT avg_reaction - 2 * range FROM stats);
